description: This Java source file defines the ScreenCaptureFragment class, which manages the UI and functionality for capturing the device's screen using Android's MediaProjection API. It handles permissions, manages the virtual display, and provides start/stop controls for screen capture.

classes.name: ScreenCaptureFragment
classes.description: A Fragment that provides UI and logic for screen capturing using MediaProjection API.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment, restores saved state including result code and data.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes UI elements after view creation, sets click listeners.

methods.name: onActivityCreated
methods.description: Sets up display metrics and media projection manager.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves current state (result code and data).

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles toggle button clicks to start or stop screen capture.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles result of media projection permission request and initiates capture setup.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Stops screen capture when fragment pauses.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up media projection resources when fragment is destroyed.

methods.name: setUpMediaProjection
methods.description: Initializes MediaProjection object with permission data.

methods.name: startScreenCapture
methods.description: Begins the screen capture process, requesting permission if necessary.

methods.name: setUpVirtualDisplay
methods.description: Creates a virtual display for screen content rendering.

methods.name: stopScreenCapture
methods.description: Releases the virtual display to stop capturing.
